diagnosticDetail: org.pytorch.executorch.llm.error error 32 (NotFound) during TextRunner.load() on iPhone 15 Pro (iOS 26.2.1). Model: Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-SpinQuant_INT4_EO8.pte (1.06 GB). Backend: XNNPACK only (backend_mps and backend_coreml not linked in this build). Device has 8 GB RAM. Failure occurred before any token generation; no raw output produced. Precise load stage not isolated — ExecuTorch error 32 (NotFound) can originate at method lookup, backend init, memory planning, or tensor resolution. Method-table inspection tooling is not available in this environment, so the exact missing resource is unverified.
rationale: The XNNPACK-only build cannot load the SpinQuant INT4 model on this device. The load fails with error 32 (NotFound) before any token generation. The precise stage is not isolated: error 32 can originate at method lookup, backend init, memory planning, or tensor resolution, and method-table inspection tooling is not available in this environment. The model card documents Android/ARM CPU targeting with no iOS claims, so the failure is consistent with an artifact-targeting mismatch. This is not a device capability failure.

evidence.rootCauseSource: Unverified. Error 32 stage not isolated; see correctionNote.

correctionNote: 2026-07-28: the original rationale for this record asserted that error 32 indicated 'an invalid argument or unsupported kernel configuration during model initialization.' That claim was retracted. It stated a specific failure stage that was never isolated, and it contradicted this record's own diagnosticDetail. The raw observation (load fails with error 32, no output produced) is unchanged.
